# I01 · Credential registry and source-aware expiry

Read AGENTS.md, docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html, docs/credentials-and-logins/index.html, registry-design.json and runbooks.json in that Dossier (source AGT-2968). Preserve the operator's recorded decision choices; otherwise use the recommended working assumptions carried by promote-concept, without claiming sight review occurred. The deployment contract is docs/deployment-story/index.html (AGT-W63, source AGT-2906); the authority and replay contract is docs/task-server-bus/index.html (AGT-W65, source AGT-2905). Use one Task Server authority per installation. Keep Git and task/workspace mutations in platform APIs, never the coding agent. Do not log secrets or browser codes. Any model or thinking selection follows docs/system/domains/model-routing-policy.md; this slice selects none.

Decisions: D1, D4, D5.
Dependencies: None; foundational metadata slice.. Resolve slice IDs to promoted task keys and require their accepted contracts before dependent implementation; do not silently assume APIs exist.

Context
ProviderCredentialMonitor reads fixed native Claude/Codex paths and a 14-day window, while the reported Claude authority is an environment token. File timestamps, refreshable access-token expiry and actual renewal deadlines currently risk being conflated.

Deliver
Implement the typed secret-free registry from registry-design.json in the installation's authoritative store, with source adapters on the owning host. Begin with Claude environment/native selection, Codex effective native store and all current GitHub, principal, WireGuard and SSH inventory kinds. Optional API-key/TLS/archive kinds may be unmanaged until their adapter lands, but require owner and manual renewal metadata. Add generation, observed source, null/unknown dates, issuer dependency and consumer adoption. Keep ProviderCredentialMonitor as metadata extraction; replace earliest-recursive-expiry logic with kind-specific semantics. Record shadowed files without making them authoritative. Implement durable hourly 14/7/1 warning deduplication and separately labelled rotation due dates. Expose metadata through authenticated read endpoints; no secret resolution endpoint for Studio. Do not build the UI or issue credentials here.

Acceptance
- An active Claude env token is never marked expired from a stale native file.
- Unknown creation/expiry stays null; modification time never becomes lastVerifiedAt.
- Codex access expiry schedules refresh verification rather than human expiry warnings.
- Fake-time coverage proves 14/7/1 thresholds, offline threshold crossing, restart deduplication and closure after replacement.
- Unauthorised readers/hosts cannot read or change other credential metadata; secret-shaped values are excluded from records and audit.
- One record can track multiple consumers and repository scopes without treating 62 aliases as 62 logins.

Verification and boundary
Inspect runner/ProviderCredentialMonitor.cs, runner/ProviderAuthEnvironment.cs, runner/RunnerCapabilityProbe.cs, backend/Features/Management/ProviderAuthProvisioning.cs and the selected server store. Use fake native stores and dummy token fixtures, including malformed metadata and duplicate env sources. Do not read production secret values or change claim policy.

Add docs-index rows for newly added docs. Use deterministic boundary tests for new state transitions; run relevant live proof only on an authorised disposable scope. # I02 · Provider evidence and incident classification

Any model or thinking selection follows docs/system/domains/model-routing-policy.md; this slice selects none.

Decisions: D2.
Dependencies: I01 registry identity, source and generation.. Resolve slice IDs to promoted task keys and require their accepted contracts before dependent implementation; do not silently assume APIs exist.

Context
ProviderAccessClassifier extracts explicit auth/quota/refusal/transient signals. ProviderAuthProbe uses login-status commands and process outcomes. The reported 26 September Codex 401 was a provider incident but led to credential gating.

Deliver
Extend the existing probes with a typed observation contract and pure correlated decision policy. Name credential-unavailable, provider-incident, quota-exhausted and network-failure, plus healthy/indeterminate. Separate credential validity from service availability. Resolve the actual source; retain existing status probes, timeout, low priority, single-flight behavior and signal/stop exclusions. Reuse fresh successful provider exchanges or issue a bounded minimal call with no repo/tools and a configured spend ceiling. Correlate a relevant fresh official status incident or an independently authenticated recently successful host canary with identical normalised request/failure. No cross-host credential copying. Compare service/auth realm, CLI/config/network and lineage; unavailable feed/comparator means uncertainty. Preserve ProviderRejectedRequest for entitlement/model refusals. This slice produces evidence and decisions, not fleet/UI policy.

Acceptance
- Replay the reported Codex 401 with relevant official status evidence: provider-incident, never forced expiry.
- Replay the same 401 without corroboration: indeterminate, not automatic renewal.
- Missing active source, non-refreshable expiry and explicit revocation remain credential-unavailable even if an unrelated incident exists.
- A stale or wrong-service incident and a shared-lineage comparison cannot corroborate an outage.
- Quota, transport and request refusal remain distinct; quoted error text and intentional termination do not poison auth health.
- All excerpts/signatures are redacted before persistence; no raw key prefix or value is retained.

Verification and boundary
Use contracts/TaskServer.Contracts/ProviderAccessClassifier.cs and runner/RunnerCapabilityProbe.cs with fake clock, HTTP/status responses and launchers. Add regression fixtures first. Document live-call adapter assumptions against installed CLI versions. A live provider smoke requires explicit probe budget and authorised account; if absent, report that exact unverified boundary without replacing it with a mocked success claim.

Decisions: D2, D5.
Dependencies: I01 registry contract and I02 evidence policy.. Resolve slice IDs to promoted task keys and require their accepted contracts before dependent implementation; do not silently assume APIs exist.

Context
Both file-backed backend and standalone Task Server have capability/claim paths. A new reason must not become a provider-wide host drain or an unavailable state that always asks for sign-in.

Deliver
Version provider-auth credentialHealth advertisements and consume them in both supported server paths. Bind host, role, credential generation, sequence and TTL; reject stale/out-of-order updates. Implement the Dossier outcome matrix: credential failures park only dependent claims and create one renewal item; corroborated incidents pause the evidenced scope with an elected 30/60/120-second jittered canary and no action-required operator item; quota uses its reset policy; network uses connectivity policy. Indeterminate failures pause affected new claims and escalate diagnostics after ten minutes, while routine timeout retains last-good only until its five-minute deadline. Persist deduplicated incident/warning state and policy revision, not only in-memory latches. Resume after two real successes at least 30 seconds apart, then verify each host. Keep active leases and retry budgets intact. Roll out server support before new producers and give legacy consumers a conservative projection with reason.

Acceptance
- Tests cover identical admission decisions in backend/Features/Tasks/LeaseEndpoints.cs, review admission and task-server/TaskServerCapabilityStore.cs.
- An incident creates zero renewal items across many hosts; repeated missing-credential reports create one scoped item.
- Healthy providers and credential-free review remain eligible; other accounts are not parked without matching scope.
- Restart, duplicate delivery and stale-generation evidence neither reopen old warnings nor clear a new failure.
- Two-success recovery removes only the matching pause; task retry counters do not increase during outage.
- Old/new protocol combinations remain conservative and visible without falsely labelling incidents as expired login.

Verification and boundary
Read docs/concepts/orchestrator-drive-to-conclusion.html before changing outcome/retry logic; maintain its incident log in this implementation card. Exercise fake-time canary election, jitter bounds, TTL and restart persistence. Reuse runner/TaskServerConnectivityMonitor.cs and existing quota/capability recovery paths. No UI redesign or credential rotation in this slice.

Decisions: D1, D3, D4.
Dependencies: I01 to I03; registry and claim pause/recovery available.. Resolve slice IDs to promoted task keys and require their accepted contracts before dependent implementation; do not silently assume APIs exist.

Context
backend/Features/Management/ClaudeSignIn.cs, CodexSignIn.cs and ProviderAuthProvisioning.cs already provide host-side login and protected installation. The new process must record each adoption and prove a real provider call, not reimplement login.

Deliver
Implement a durable typed maintenance-operation contract with host/credential generation CAS, operation/step idempotency, actor grants, deadline, lease and replay journal. Wrap existing SSH adapters first; add authenticated host polling transport without an inbound runner listener. Preserve independent management recovery for broken Runner credentials. Use the Dossier state machine and versioned allowlisted steps. Browser URL/code is ephemeral and visible only to the initiating session, never ordinary logs or bus history. Claude stages host setup-token output, verifies, atomically updates provider-auth.env, reconciles runner.env precedence, safely replaces Coding and guarded Review, verifies each adopted generation and makes a clean-context real call. Codex device login drains refresh writers unless CLI concurrency is proved; preserve host lineage, reconcile hard-link/atomic-replacement behavior and verify future launches. Busy Review is pending, not success. Never copy workstation login files.

Acceptance
- Cancel, timeout, duplicate request, server restart and host disconnect replay without duplicate issuance or overwriting a newer generation.
- Wrong-host/wrong-scope actor is denied; expected-generation conflict is explicit.
- Human browser step remains required and secrets/codes are absent from every persisted surface.
- Coding restart reattaches the same worker/fence; busy Review guard is respected and resumes after drain.
- A token written to disk but not adopted by every installed consumer cannot complete renewal.
- Tests cover CLI atomic rename breaking an alias, concurrent refresh writer handling and failed real-call verification with safe rollback.

Verification and boundary
Use dummy credentials for transport/redaction tests, disposable stores and fake login process streams. Use existing reattachment and Review drain tests, then an authorised bounded live provider renewal/probe when the owner is available; record browser/live boundaries if unavailable. Do not weaken unit guards or restore stale OAuth backups.

# I05 · GitHub credential access and rotation

Decisions: D1, D3, D5.
Dependencies: I01 inventory and I04 operation protocol.. Resolve slice IDs to promoted task keys and require their accepted contracts before dependent implementation; do not silently assume APIs exist.

Context
The runner reportedly has product HTTPS credentials but needed a distinct ed25519 deploy key for the workspace repository. The registration used workstation OAuth authority, whose revocation can delete dependent deploy keys.

Deliver
Add GitHub adapters for host-local deploy-key generation, authorised public-key registration, protected HTTPS helper replacement and OAuth reauthorisation metadata. Record exact repository, read/write grants, key ID, fingerprint, owner and issuerCredentialRef. Rotation creates a second distinct key, verifies read and platform-owned permitted write, switches new Git operations, acknowledges adoption, then retires old public key after in-flight operations finish. Use idempotent registration reconciliation by operation marker/public fingerprint before retrying a timed-out API call. Keep registration OAuth credential on controller; never distribute it to runners. Resolve all issuer-token/deploy-key dependencies before revocation. Human issuance remains explicit for token types without an API. Do not alter product repository credentials while repairing workspace access.

Acceptance
- The RB-GITHUB-WORKSPACE fixture proves product repository success is insufficient for workspace access.
- Private key stays on host; registration uses public key only; remotes remain credential-free.
- A duplicate registration retry adopts the existing matching key rather than creating or revoking unrelated keys.
- Read verification and actual permitted temporary-ref write/publication receipt use the intended identity; ls-remote or dry-run alone cannot mark write healthy.
- Rotation keeps old key until successful adoption; failure removes only the unused new key by recorded ID.
- OAuth issuer revocation is blocked/deferred until dependent keys have independent verified replacement.

Verification and boundary
Use a fake GitHub API for retries, lost acknowledgements and issuer cascade; use a disposable private repository for authorised platform Git canaries. Validate temporary-ref cleanup. Coding agents do not execute commits/pushes for this task; platform-owned test adapters do. Document unsupported repository policies and issuer overlap limits.

# I06 · Task Server principal rotation with adoption

Read AGENTS.md, docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html, docs/credentials-and-logins/index.html, registry-design.json and runbooks.json in that Dossier (source AGT-2968). Any model or thinking selection follows docs/system/domains/model-routing-policy.md; this slice selects none.

Decisions: D3, D5.
Dependencies: I01 metadata and I04 operation protocol.. Resolve slice IDs to promoted task keys and require their accepted contracts before dependent implementation; do not silently assume APIs exist.

Context
task-server/TaskServerPrincipalStore.cs already hashes credentials and rotates with default 300-second overlap capped at 3600 seconds. The expiry clock currently begins before clients acknowledge replacement, which is insufficient for promised unattended continuity.

Deliver
Extend the existing issuer with idempotent staged generation and explicit adoption/retirement state, preserving hashes, principal scope and revocation semantics. Preflight consumers, issue/store new protected client material, authenticate from each client and prove next lease heartbeat before starting bounded old-generation retirement. Maximum grace is finite and visible; offline consumers defer planned rotation rather than silently expiring. Implement independently authenticated recovery if the client credential is already unusable. Support Studio, Engine and per-host Runner roles distinctly. Add a legacy enrolled rnr credential adapter only against its owning backend API; where overlap is unsupported, advertise bounded maintenance and drain. Do not pretend the two auth profiles are identical. Compromise revocation remains immediate even if availability is lost.

Acceptance
- All three principal roles rotate while active authenticated requests continue using accepted generations.
- A run lease heartbeat survives planned rotation without changing attempt/fence ownership.
- Lost adoption receipt and process restart reconcile idempotently; secrets are never returned twice through ordinary read endpoints.
- Offline consumer preflight prevents a false zero-downtime completion; finite grace and recovery route are explicit.
- Privilege escalation, cross-host rotation and using Runner authority to mint administrator grants are denied.
- Legacy unsupported overlap follows maintenance semantics and cannot be reported seamless.

Verification and boundary
Run focused principal authentication/rotation store and active-lease integration tests using fake clock and disposable server state. Verify hashed storage and log/body redaction. Document server API compatibility and recovery bootstrap; do not create a parallel credential issuer.

- WireGuard cutover succeeds through a second route or safely rolls back; overlapping AllowedIPs are not treated as a seamless plan.

Operation progress survives navigation/reload via server state; duplicate clicks do not start duplicate renewals.
Unauthorised actions are unavailable and server-enforced; browser URL/code is restricted to initiating session.
Flat layout, keyboard navigation, narrow viewport and both themes pass relevant Playwright coverage with no page errors.
Real light/dark captures prove visible states with exact captions, capture dates and provenance in canonical full-bleed figures.

implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# I09 · Credential incident replay and rollout gate

Read AGENTS.md, docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html, docs/credentials-and-logins/index.html, registry-design.json and runbooks.json in that Dossier (source AGT-2968). Preserve the operator's recorded decision choices; otherwise use the recommended working assumptions carried by promote-concept, without claiming sight review occurred. The deployment contract is docs/deployment-story/index.html (AGT-W63, source AGT-2906); the authority and replay contract is docs/task-server-bus/index.html (AGT-W65, source AGT-2905). Use one Task Server authority per installation. Keep Git and task/workspace mutations in platform APIs, never the coding agent. Do not log secrets or browser codes. Any model or thinking selection follows docs/system/domains/model-routing-policy.md; this slice selects none.

Decisions: D1 to D5 as recorded.
Dependencies: I01 to I08 accepted; roll out in observe-only mode first.. Resolve slice IDs to promoted task keys and require their accepted contracts before dependent implementation; do not silently assume APIs exist.

Context
The three September incidents must become durable operational knowledge. runbooks.json records what was reported, what remains unknown and which evidence permits automatic action. Current historical reports are not reproduced runtime evidence.

Deliver
Implement the versioned typed runbook catalogue and allowlisted executor integration for RB-CLAUDE-LINEAGE, RB-CODEX-INCIDENT and RB-GITHUB-WORKSPACE. Pin runbook version into operation receipts and expose one scoped action with required human steps. Reproduce each failure in deterministic integration scenarios before enabling new admission policy. Include stale Claude file versus env token, Codex request 401 with relevant status incident, identical 401 without corroboration, and workspace Git denial despite product access. Test process/server restart, lost receipt, partial consumer adoption and generation conflicts across each safe boundary. Define rollout/rollback telemetry with no secret collection; keep central state through policy rollback. Publish operator runbooks, links and Dossier navigation after verification without claiming human sight review.

Acceptance
- All three incident replays assert correct classification, bounded fleet reaction, owner and completion predicate.
- Confirmed Codex incident produces zero renewal items and zero task retry-budget increments; absence of incident proof remains indeterminate.
- Claude renewal records host source and all consumer adoption without copied refresh lineage.
- Workspace access records key/issuer dependency and verified exact repository grants.
- Restart/replay cannot execute arbitrary prose, repeat already-completed Git side effects or overwrite a newer secret generation.
- One-box and available distributed live canaries demonstrate capability recovery and secret-free receipts; unavailable prerequisites are named rather than marked passed.

Verification and boundary
Read docs/concepts/orchestrator-drive-to-conclusion.html before any outcome changes and record reproduced incident terminals. Run bounded scenario suites for the actual supported server/profile matrix; no broad soak without an unresolved failure. Use authorised disposable live accounts/hosts for final proof. Do not automatically renew production credentials during observe-only rollout. Record measured classification/recovery times and enable admission changes only after the acceptance gate passes.

Report changed files, exact checks and any unverified live assumption. Update the affected operational contract and the Dossier implementation log after delivery. Add docs-index rows for newly added docs. Use deterministic boundary tests for new state transitions; run relevant live proof only on an authorised disposable scope. Do not rotate a production credential merely to test the implementation.
